title: OKR orchestration: initiative commitment notary & alignment runway
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Scope: Create a lightweight but enforceable company-level mechanism (the 'Commitment Notary') that records and validates cross-functional initiative commitments against company OKRs, and an 'Alignment Runway' to operationalize cadence, guardrails, and escalation. This ticket produces the artifact templates, one dashboard, a rollout plan, and the decision protocol for exceptions.

Why: Current OKR -> initiative handoff is ambiguous: PMs, Eng leads, and Design report different scopes and success metrics at planning. This causes late re-scopes, missed deliveries, and diluted OKR signal. The Commitment Notary is a single source-of-truth template (signed by stakeholders) plus a minimal compliance check during planning and mid-cycle reviews.

Deliverables: 
- Commitment Notary template (Confluence doc + JSON manifest) that captures OKR mapping, success metrics (north-star & guardrail), committed work (initiative slices), owners, and rollback/fallback policy.
- Alignment Runway playbook: sequence for pre-cycle sign-off, weekly health checks, mid-cycle revalidation, and escalation flow.
- Observability: a Dashboard (Console link) that surfaces commitment drift, at-risk initiatives, and top dependencies.
- Tooling: small validation script to flag inconsistencies (GitHub gist + CI check for release PRs).
- Training: 1-hour workshop and a 15-minute quick guide for leads.

Acceptance criteria: 
1) Notary template approved by PM, Eng, and Design review boards. 
2) Dashboard shows live statuses for >70% of company initiatives in pilot orgs. 
3) Validation script runs as a lightweight gating check on at least two repo PRs associated with initiative rollouts.
4) Workshop delivered and feedback score >= 4/5 from pilot participants.

Out of scope: Enforced gating across the entire org in Q1; full automation of scoring (future phase).
